content: Support of periodic transmission type 2 If DcmDspPeriod- icTransmissionSchedulerType is set to SCHEDULER_TYPE2 the Dcm is set up to send PDIDs and the periodic transmission rate for a scheduler elapses, the Dcm shall trigger the transmission of the next scheduled PDIDs on all available periodic connections.
